senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) the hollow of the hand formed by bending the fingers so as to touch the wrist, contrad. to קֹמֶץ; a handful.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:7">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> <he>חָפְנוֹ של משה</he> the quantity of a handful of Moses’ hand.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 11:5">Ex. R. s. 11</cite> <he>מלא ח׳ שלו מלא ח׳ וכ׳</he> his (Moses’) handful and that of Aaron; a. fr.—Du. <he>חָפְנַיִם</he>, <he>חוֹפְנַיִם</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:1">Yoma V, 1</cite> <he>מלא הָפְנָיו</he> his two handfuls.

<cite ref="Yoma 47a:1">Ib. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>חוֹפְנָיו</he>. Ex. R. l. c. <he>לקחו … חָפְנֵיהֶם</he> both of them took, each his handfuls; a. fr. [<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:14">Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 14</cite> <he>חפן</he> ed., read <cite ref="O01388"><he>סַפָּן</he></cite> as ed. Zuck.].
